title: Download page files or images
description: Download detected files or images of a page into the browser's Downloads folder, as the Files panel's download does, by fileId from the latest dsagent.page.files.detect (at most 50 per call). Only http and https addresses download; the result lists the fileIds that did not.
guidance: The browser saves each under its file name, numbering duplicates. Requires an idempotency key: repeating a key with the same files returns the first result without downloading again.

inputSchema.description: The page and the files to download.

pageContextId.description: Opaque page context from dsagent.pages.list or dsagent.page.open.

items.description: A fileId from the latest dsagent.page.files.detect of this page.

pageContextId.description: Opaque page context from dsagent.pages.list or dsagent.page.open.

items.description: One file not downloaded and why.

fileId.description: A fileId from the latest dsagent.page.files.detect of this page.

reason.description: not-detected: the latest detect of the page has no such fileId (detect again); not-http: the address is not http or https.
